headline: Marban Hollow Swings as Weathered Expanse Works Go Idle
war_summary:
Since the last edition the lines have shifted at Marban Hollow, its ledger now reading four Colonial works, two Warden and two unclaimed, a turn from the four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral logged three hours past. Checkpoint Bua bears the brunt of thirty-six actions in the day and six in the last two hours, and it was there the latest filing was made.

Weathered Expanse has yielded another Warden work to no man's land, leaving five held and four unclaimed; forty-eight actions in the day and twelve in six hours persist about Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest.

Palantine Berm has given up one Colonial work, now four Colonial to two Warden and one unclaimed, though fifty-three actions in the day and ten in two hours keep Vendett and Windburn Landing in dispute. Linn Mercy records a Warden work restored beside nine Colonial and one neutral, while Stonecradle holds at two Warden against seven Colonial.

Godcrofts has flared anew, eleven actions in two hours of twenty in the day at Fleecewatch, Isawa and Ursa Base, its Warden casualties in the day far exceeding the Colonial toll. Callahan's Passage reports no change of works. The victory mark stands at thirty-four towns.
